Name: TARDIS (PIF)
Author: emurphy42
Description:
I saw the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]PIF framework[/url] and of course I had to do this.

Provides multiple styles and custom audio. Does not provide any interior maps; you'll need to install at least one other PIF content pack that does.

Thanks to DeLiXx for the framework, and Sharogg for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25942]Entrance to Narnia[/url] which was an excellent example of how to put all the pieces together in practice.

Manifest.Name: TARDIS (PIF)
Manifest.Description: Enter a TARDIS from your farmhouse.
Manifest.Author: John Peters (you know, the farmer?)
